answer: Post a bond. Attest only peers you have not funded. Require a panel spanning unrelated subnetworks before payout clears. Those three rules break the cheapest sybil, because a self-funded ring earns reciprocity only from itself and a non-diverse panel voids the claim outright. What breaks first is honest small operators in a young lagoon, since unrelated peers are scarce early. Cost to an attacker: a copper bond per identity plus the walnut of buying genuine cross-cluster attestations.
